arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Kirkland stated the classification determines how courts assess invalid factors.
Ms. Rivkind argued the jury instructions show the law is a weighing statute.
Justice Souter questioned the differentiation from other states' eligibility factor instructions.
Justice Kennedy noted the distinction is artificial but serves a specific purpose.
